column1: # Hooks that emulator/hookcheck.py would fail, and that are accepted. Columns (tab-separated): address of the
# jump or of the pointer word and its target as ADDRESS>TARGET (several of one reason: separated by spaces), date, class,
# reason. An entry accepts that address with that target only. A range is not an entry: each word is listed. An entry needs evidence from the camera or a proof from the code. Keep this list short.
# The class says how strong the reason is (the rule: docs/dev/load-order.md, section 2). `epm2mod lint` prints each
# row of class inferred or timing that a build uses.
#   proof     the code shows that the path starts only from late-loaded code.
#   inferred  the path needs something the application does (a capture, a movie frame). The reading can be wrong.
#   timing    the path can run from early-loaded code at any time; the camera's logs show that it runs after the
#             copies, on the bodies and in the modes that were measured. An open risk.
# How each row got its class (2026-11-25, from the reason texts below and load-order.md sections 2 and 5):
#   proof: the two task entry words 7E439C80 and 7E439C9C. The tasks are dormant in stock and the one call that
#   inferred: the 10 hooks of the ART bracket frame composer 0x7E5A75AE (7E5A7AFA, 7E5A774B, 7E5A7B6D, 7E5A7B9B,
#     7E5A776E, 7E5A7664, 7E5A76FD, 7E5A7724, 7E5A7A2D, 7E5A7B17). Static: the composer runs when an ART bracket
#     picture is taken. That a capture needs the application is a reading, not a proof. Their reason texts say
#     "timing only": the texts are older than the classes and say that no proof exists, which inferred also says.
#     The path is a capture, the row of the rule for inferred.
#     Also inferred: the 4 hooks of movie-ab (7E6CB8B3, 7E54A2CE, 7E54A5E9, 7E7290F4): movie frames and art passes
#     only, by a reading of the callers. Never on the camera.
#   timing: the two colour-stage hooks 7E56C6A5 and 7E546160, and the 48 colour-stage table words (7E78AEBC-7E78B00C,
#     7E78C194-7E78CB40). The colour stage runs for live view at power-on, so only the measured time (first stage
#     1.6 to 2.9 s after the start, 1.28 s after the copies, two bodies, P) keeps it after the copies.
#     Also timing: the 25 table words of the hidden art values (7E7FF034-7E7FF0A4, 7E807858-7E8078C8,
#     7E854A50-7E854A6C). One of their switches is called by the live-view struct refresh that ran before
#     segment 2 was loaded in issue #6. No measurement covers a cold start with one of these values selected: the

Accepted on camera evidence: flashed in every film build from remap7b-code (2026-11-12) to films-twelve-off (2026-11-21); docs/camera-log/ records no failed start or update. card-looks-9, kernel data to segment 3. The entry word of task 0x90 (USRTEST_A) in the CPU0 task table.
